offence_note: Five counts of mischief (traffic obstruction) and breach of release order
sentence_quote: A custodial sentence of seven days was imposed for the breach of his release order.
note: Appeal only on applying 9 days pre-trial credit to the mischief CSO rather than the 7-day breach sentence.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm on a bus driver
sentence_quote: Your sentence will be two years' incarceration in addition to the 215 days credit for the time you have already served in jail.
note: Joint submission; total about 31 months; guilty plea held hardly mitigating; victim surcharge via default formula.

offence_note: Home invasion break and enter with robbery; breach of probation and recognizance
sentence_quote: the nine month sentence for breach of probation and the nine month sentence for breach of recognizance are to be served concurrently and that those concurrent sentences are be served consecutive to the eight year sentence for break and entry
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; breach sentences made concurrent, cutting total from 9y 6m to 8y 9m.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I sentence you to 22 months incarceration.
note: Conditional sentence refused on community safety grounds.

offence_note: Second-degree murder and two aggravated assaults
sentence_quote: I impose on you a life sentence with no eligibility for parole for 12 years for the offences set out in the indictment, to be served concurrently.
note: Joint submission accepted; aggravated assaults 5 and 7 years concurrent; credit 851 days at 1.5 is 1277 days.

offence_note: Offences not shown; sentence appeal dismissed
sentence_quote: The appeal as to sentence is dismissed.
note: Short endorsement; sentence and offences not described; court urges CSC to meet appellant's medical needs.

offence_note: Predicate offences not described; dangerous offender designation set aside
sentence_quote: The appeal must therefore be allowed, the dangerous offender designation set aside, and a new sentencing hearing held.
note: New sentencing hearing ordered because long-term offender criteria were not considered.

offence_note: Firearm trafficking, unauthorized possession, possession contrary to order, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: order that the sentence be adjusted to reflect credit at the rate of 1.5:1 for the entire period of 1,092 days
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave granted; credit raised from 3.92 to 4.488 years; custody term unchanged.

offence_note: Break and enter of neighbours' home and theft therein
sentence_quote: I am satisfied that the joint recommendation for an 18-month Conditional Sentence Order, with stringent conditions, followed by an 18-month term of probation, is neither contrary to the public interest
note: Joint recommendation accepted; restitution 1523.10 plus 1280.80 to two victims.
